# Demand forecasting API

## Problem
A grocery chain with 40 stores suffered frequent stock-outs and over-ordering of perishables.

## Solution
I built a time series forecasting service with Prophet and scikit-learn gradient boosting, exposed through a FastAPI endpoint and packaged with Docker. Weekly retraining ran on a schedule.

## Result
Stock-outs fell by 18 percent within two months and the ops team trusted the forecasts enough to automate reorders.
